# ElastiCache

Manage Redis, Valkey, and Memcached resources with an optional Docker cache runtime.

**Status: implemented subset.** Operation selection does not imply complete input or behavior parity.

| Contract | Current implementation |
| --- | --- |
| Service ID | `elasticache` |
| Signing name | `elasticache` |
| Wire protocol | AWS Query |
| API version | `2015-02-02` |
| Scope | Account and region |
| Execution | Records / optional Docker |
| Selected operations | 32 of 75 in the pinned model |

## Implemented behavior

See the [implemented feature catalogue](catalogue.md#elasticache) for this service's capabilities.

## Limitations and future work

- The console has no snapshot or final-snapshot options and cannot change node type, which the service fixes at creation; engine versions can only be upgraded, and node counts only change for Memcached.
- Cache data is lost when containers are removed on shutdown or restart; persistent mode retains metadata only.
- Host ports can change when nodes restart.
- Production networking, topology and failover behavior are not reproduced.
- Multi-shard cluster mode, snapshots/backups and RBAC users/user groups are outside the subset.
- Reset removes the cache containers it started; a node starting during the reset can outlive it until shutdown.

These gaps describe current boundaries and possible follow-up slices. The [roadmap](../roadmap/index.md)
separates proposed work from registered functionality; there are no promised release dates.
